name: columns
description: Multi-column layout with optional ratio support. Columns are separated by === delimiter in the shortcode inner content. No JavaScript required.

params.description: Column width ratio, e.g. '1:2' for narrow-left, wide-right. Default: equal columns.
params.effect: Sets --mdf-col-ratio CSS variable and adds mdf-columns--1-2 class

css.note: No standalone CSS. Sub-theme styles .mdf-columns and .mdf-column in main.css. Recommended: CSS Grid with var(--mdf-col-ratio).

css_in_main.note: Define column layout in main.css. Example: .mdf-columns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }

partials.note: Override to customize the column wrapper structure or change the === delimiter
